title: Grid tactics with character-focused commands and aim-window attacks
intent: Screenshot-based design mockups, not implemented gameplay
nativeSize: Measured in verification.json; original generated pixels copied without editing or upscaling.
userRequirements: Move and choose a target on a tactical grid, then transition behind the acting character.
Exactly four commands: Attack, Skill, Burst, Item.
A line moves back and forth across a bar; the player clicks while it is inside the highlighted interval.
Highlight position and width can vary by skill; success awards extra damage.
No reactive dodge/parry and no Defend command.
assumptions: An outside-window click still deals base damage.
Skill values, charge costs, window sizes and bonus percentages are illustrative.
Burst example is an alternative to the main skill sequence, not the next action in that sequence.
The intended implementation keeps actors on the same map. AI mockups may change small geometry and enemy details between cameras.

images.title: Move on the grid
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: a single polished 16:9 in-game screenshot concept for this existing 3D game, landscape, full bleed. This is a grid-tactics / character-focused turn-based hybrid, grounded in the supplied actual screenshots, not a redesign of the art direction. Preserve the game's small chibi Snow White: short silver-white hair, black goggles on head, white cape, dark armored outfit, oversized white/black/gold sniper rifle. Ivory/dark mechanical Rapture enemies with red cores, painted mossy stone paths, ruined ivy walls, cream/gold sci-fi architecture and cyan light, daylight and practical existing-game asset quality. Existing UI visual language: flat dark navy translucent panels, steel bevel outlines, cyan selections, muted gold accents, clean legible condensed typography, hex portraits and hex ability frames. Use the existing bottom UI rather than abilities beside the character.
Combat state for this whole sequence: TURN 4, Snow White is active, HP 1450/1450; target PELICAN has HP 300/300; party includes Crown, Scarlet, Rapunzel. A proposed skill named PIERCING SHOT deals 120 base damage, with +30 extra damage (+25%) for timing success, total 150. These are illustrative values. No random hit chance. The battlefield is one continuous location: courtyard stone road toward a cyan relay on raised steps at far right, low mossy cover wall on the left of Snow White, another broken wall near the right side of the target, trees and broken perimeter walls. One large selected Pelican ahead, two smaller enemies further back. The cinematic camera simply moves behind Snow White on her actual grid tile; actors never enter a separate battle arena. Keep this exact scene consistent in following screenshots.
Absolute action-menu rule: the only four character commands are ATTACK, SKILL, BURST, ITEM, in that order, singular words. Never add Defend, Guard, Wait, Flee, dodge, parry, shield command, or real-time weakpoint/crosshair aiming. Timing minigame is a HORIZONTAL BAR with one thin line traveling left and right through a fixed highlighted SECTION. The click is anywhere, not a spatial shot at the enemy. UI and character proportions should look shippable with the current assets; no realistic human proportions or ornate fantasy HUD. No watermark.
For this image: HIGH ISOMETRIC TACTICAL GRID VIEW, closely follow the composition and environment of reference 1 (previous tactics concept), use reference 2 for actual world materials and reference 3 for current HUD style; reference 4 for actual hero. Replace all old mechanics/UI text with this specification. Eight-by-eight-ish readable square grid follows ground perspective. Snow White stands lower center-left on a cyan selected tile, Crown to her upper left behind short cover, Rapunzel lower left, Scarlet lower center. Three enemies only, one large Pelican upper right-center before the cyan relay steps and two smaller machines behind. Cyan movement-range tiles, a short cyan dashed path to ONE gold destination tile in a gap between low walls, with a translucent ghost preview of Snow White there. This move gives a clear lane to the Pelican. Do not show a full clone character outside the transparent destination preview.
Top left compact objective "SEIZE THE RELAY". Top center "SNOW WHITE'S TURN" with small "TURN 4" and a short initiative strip. Bottom left faithful hex Snow White portrait with "SNOW WHITE", "1450 / 1450", "MOVE 5". Bottom center wide flat navy instruction panel, exact text "CHOOSE A TILE" and smaller "LMB Confirm move". Bottom right three compact squad portraits labeled CROWN, SCARLET, RAPUNZEL. No action command menu yet; movement and target selection happen BEFORE the four-command close view. No end-turn/wait/guard button. Preserve lots of battlefield visibility, crisp cyan movement squares and cover silhouettes. Upper-right tiny designator "01 / MOVE" for storyboard continuity.

images.title: Choose a skill and see its bonus
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the supplied screenshot non-destructively to show the next UI step of this SAME tactical/JRPG turn. Maintain EXACT camera, characters, weapons, enemies, environment, lighting, their positions, top initiative bar, all health values and all portraits. Snow White's HP remains 1450/1450 and selected PELICAN remains 300/300. Keep the four hex command buttons at bottom center with EXACT labels ATTACK, SKILL, BURST, ITEM. SKILL has active cyan outline; other buttons remain visible. Top-right stage badge changes to "04 / SKILL".
Open a well-designed flat navy skill-selection panel just ABOVE the command row at lower center/right, leaving enemy silhouette and Snow White's face/shoulder/rifle readable. Use crisp steel outlines, cyan highlights and gold bonus text. Panel consists of a narrow left list of TWO proposed skills "Piercing Shot" selected cyan, "Armor Break" unselected; and a slightly wider right detail section. Title "PIERCING SHOT". Detail text exactly: "120 BASE DAMAGE", "+30 TIMING BONUS", "Cost: 1 charge  /  Available: 2". Add a miniature preview of its aim-window BAR under these values: a horizontal dark track with exactly ONE gold highlighted SECTION at 70-86% of the width, no moving cursor yet. Under it exact text "Click inside the window for +25% damage". This is a preview, not an active minigame. Small button within panel "CONFIRM SKILL"; footer "LMB Confirm  /  Esc Back".
Make the panel compact and readable like a real game screenshot; do not overfill with extra explanations. This preview has no hit-chance, no crit-chance, no cooldown seconds, no parry/dodge/guard, no defend command. No spatial aiming crosshair on enemy. All existing world and UI outside this panel remain visually unchanged, especially the existing four-command menu. Single landscape screenshot.

images.title: Click while the line crosses the aim window
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the supplied screenshot into the ACTIVE TIMING MINIGAME after selecting the skill PIERCING SHOT. Lock camera, same Snow White pose aiming rifle, same scene, same targets and positions and light, top portraits, UI art direction. No muzzle flash yet, shot has not fired. Snow White 1450/1450; PELICAN 300/300 unchanged. Stage badge "05 / AIM". Keep four bottom-center hex buttons ATTACK, SKILL, BURST, ITEM in same positions; dim them as inactive while timing, with subtle cyan rim around SKILL. Bottom-left hero status and bottom-right three party portraits remain.
The primary new interface is ONE large, easily read horizontal TIMING BAR floating just above the bottom command row, over empty ground in lower center/right. Do NOT place it over Snow White's rifle or target body. Compact navy panel about 640px wide. Title "PIERCING SHOT" left and "AIM WINDOW" right. Below title: "120 base  +  30 bonus". Under that, horizontal navy track with fine white border, about 600px wide and 32px tall. Highlight exactly ONE gold interval at 70%-86% of the bar width; label this interval "BONUS +25%" just above it, with thin connector. Rest of track dark navy. ONE thin brilliant white VERTICAL LINE is currently at 42% of track length, OUTSIDE the highlighted region, with a small triangular pointer at top and a very subtle short motion trail indicating rightward travel. A slim two-ended arrow BELOW the track indicates that this single white line bounces left/right across the entire bar. Do not add multiple markers or target crosshairs. The gold interval is stationary.
Below the track prominent mouse-left-button glyph and exact instruction "LMB  Click inside the gold window". Small subtext "Outside the window: 120 damage". The whole mechanic must be visually unmistakable: line moving back and forth; fixed highlighted window; click when line is inside for EXTRA damage. This is timed clicking, not moving a reticle onto an enemy body part. No parry, dodge, guard, defend, countdown reaction prompts, or elaborate animation. Keep same scene unblurred, shooter's posture steady. Single landscape screenshot, no diagram collage.
